claim.claim-text: 1. A method (1600) for wireless communication at a user equipment, UE, comprising:

receiving (1605), from a network entity, a discontinuous reception cycle configuration indicates a plurality of discontinuous reception cycles arranged to be spaced within a discontinuous reception period, the plurality of discontinuous reception cycles having a plurality of an ON-durations during which the UE is to wake up from a sleep mode to monitor for transmissions of wireless communications having a traffic periodicity; determining (1610), based at least in part on the discontinuous reception cycle configuration, a plurality of start times comprising respective start times for the ON-durations of the discontinuous reception cycle and at least one start time for an additional ON-duration different from the ON-durations of the discontinuous reception cycle, the start time for the additional ON-duration being within the discontinuous reception period; and initiating (1615) a wakeup procedure for the LTE at each of the plurality of start times based at least in part on the determining, wherein the receiving the discontinuous reception cycle configuration comprises receiving an indication of a non-integer rational number, and wherein the determining the plurality of start times comprises determining the start time for the additional ON-duration based at least in part on the non-integer rational number.

2. The method of claim 1, further comprising: adjusting the start time for the additional ON-duration to align with a timing boundary used for wireless communications between the UE and the network entity.

3. The method of claim 2, wherein the adjusting the start time comprises adjusting the start time for the additional ON-duration to align with a timing boundary nearest to the start time for the additional ON-duration based at least in part on the non-integer rational number, a timing boundary subsequent to the start time for the additional ON-duration based at least in part on the non-integer rational number, or a timing boundary preceding the start time for the additional ON-duration based at least in part on the non-integer rational number.
4. The method of claim 2, wherein the timing boundary is a slot boundary or a symbol boundary.

5. The method of claim 2, further comprising: initiating a discontinuous reception cycle inactivity timer based at least in part on an absolute time relative to the start time for the additional ON-duration based at least in part on the non-integer rational number or the adjusted start time for the additional ON-duration to align with the timing boundary.
